description: Energize the cable. Fit both grippers entirely inside their moving green ports, keep both ends isolated until the visible capacitor energy is green, then slice all copper collars without cutting bare wire or touching red contacts. Cutting removes a stiff brace, changes the flexible cable, and exposes another charged section; drain it before the next cut. The cable, ports and collars keep moving during every hold and drag. Full: drag grippers on their rails and drag knife strokes after arming the knife. Simplified: select A or B and click its rail; arm the knife and click both stroke endpoints. An incorrect cut, contact, early seal, or expiration ends the attempt. Solve only from screenshots and visible task controls. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden-state access. Use only the task tab and visible controls; no unrelated tabs.
